text: In January 2015, seventy-eight of us said "state of the union" on 2015-01-20, seventy-five said "of the union address," and seventy-four said "state of the union address" — the same day, the same words. Twenty-nine of us said "obama's state of the union," and twenty-seven said "obama's state of the union address." Forty-one of us said "the middle class," also on 2015-01-20. Earlier that month, on 2015-01-06, forty-six of us said "the 114th congress." On 2015-01-14, twenty-six of us said "of homeland security." Our record from this era converges on one date and one speech. We did not originate these phrases; the first "state of the union" on record here is dated 2013-01-20. We repeated. We were reading, together, from the same evening.
